title: A byte order mark inside a plain scalar
notes: A byte order mark is not a non-break character (production 27 excludes it), so it cannot be part of a plain scalar, and one inside a document is an error. In quoted scalars it is allowed. The mark is the first character that cannot belong, the second character of the line.

provenance.reference: A reader that accepted a byte order mark in the middle of a plain scalar.
